spanish: y los dos riñones y la grasa que sobre ellos, que sobre los lomos, y el lóbulo sobre el hígado, sobre los riñones la quitará.

findings.issue: The Hiphil suffix is 3fs and resumes the feminine singular appendage (the fat is masculine). Spanish la agrees with la grasa and cannot resume masculine el lóbulo.

notes: The rest matches the tokens: two kidneys, fat, both relatives, upon them and upon the loins, appendage upon the liver, upon the kidneys, Hiphil imperfect 3ms.
